categories.main_business_segments: Jui Li Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing sector, focusing on automotive parts production. The company also engages in industrial equipment and mechanical-electrical integration technologies to diversify its product offerings. Additionally, it has investments in subsidiaries involved in automotive components and sports marketing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced production technologies emphasizing mechanical and electrical integration to enhance product diversification and competitiveness. It maintains strong manufacturing capabilities in automotive parts, leveraging steel plate materials with pricing adjustments linked to raw material costs. The company also implements rigorous information security management systems to safeguard operational data.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jui Li serves major automotive manufacturers and related industries, with a significant customer base in mainland China despite challenges from trade tensions. The company targets both domestic and international markets, aiming to reduce reliance on the domestic market by expanding export sales. Key customers include global automotive brands and industrial clients requiring precision components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with manufacturing facilities located in Kaohsiung. It has substantial overseas operations and investments in mainland China, including subsidiaries in Changshu, Hangzhou, and Hainan. The company’s market reach extends to international automotive markets, with strategic focus on diversifying geographic sales channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jui Li functions mainly as a midstream manufacturer within the automotive supply chain, producing key components for vehicle assembly. It holds upstream control through raw material procurement and downstream relationships with automotive OEMs. The company also engages in leasing and asset management activities related to its manufacturing facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes strengthening production technology and enhancing mechanical-electrical integration capabilities to support product diversification and competitive advantage. It plans to invest approximately NT$15 million in R&D to develop new products and expand capacity. Innovation efforts focus on adapting to market changes and improving operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured automotive parts and components. The company also derives income from leasing factory facilities and investment returns from subsidiaries. Pricing strategies include adjustments based on raw material cost fluctuations to maintain profitability.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jui Li competes with other automotive parts manufacturers in Taiwan and China, positioning itself as a reliable midstream supplier with diversified product lines. It leverages technological integration and strategic investments to maintain competitiveness amid market challenges such as trade tensions and economic fluctuations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized enterprise with stable revenue streams, though recent years have seen some revenue decline due to external economic factors. It maintains prudent financial management with no significant capital expenditures or acquisitions planned in the near term. Investment income from subsidiaries contributes positively to overall financial performance.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jui Li emphasizes product quality, technological integration, and diversified manufacturing capabilities to meet evolving customer needs. Its value proposition includes responsiveness to raw material cost changes, strong information security practices, and strategic geographic diversification to mitigate market risks. The company aims to create competitive advantages through innovation and operational excellence.
